machineFullCompare._doc: Demonstrates the HUMAN helper's short/full distinction: the 32-hex short form matches the human matchesShort helper but is not equal to the full 64-hex value. This vector does NOT by itself prove that a live machine path compares at full length. Account.resealEscrowFor does; the in-person-QR rfp and the admin sheet-confirm still use the 16-hex short id pending a later branch of this security review.
